SLE.note: The page lists startup support only as directorate functions and a prize challenge; no adopted act, strategy, label or fund is stated.

facts.fact: MoCTI's Directorate of Innovation lists a DPG Accelerator Lab with UNICEF, helping startups develop open-source digital public goods, as launching November 2025.

SLE.note: The page describes digital skills training for the public and youth only; no training for civil servants is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation lists as an active 2025 programme World Bank-supported digital skills training for 1,500 Sierra Leoneans across 16 Digital Learning Hubs.
